title: The Ask test set scores video requests too
goal: Ask and the Photonz skill are scored on drawings, component sheets, pricing and measurements, but never on a video, though a video is one of the four things Ask has to change well. Add video requests to the test set, scored from the frames the video actually plays, so a change that makes video asks worse shows up, and so the model Ask runs on is picked on video work as well as pictures.
notes: Manager 2026-10-20 19:30. Scripts/ask-eval/cases/ and held-out/ hold no video case at all (25 climbing cases: drawings, sheets, pricing, settings measurements). ask-runs-on-the-best-model-this-mac-can-hold-pic asks for a per-category table including video, which cannot be filled without these cases, so it now depends on this task. Video tools Ask has: add_title, cut, trim, move_clip, set_transition, apply_zooms (Sources/PhotonzCore/AskPlanning.swift AskTools.doing); missing from Ask but on the server: add_clip, new_video, export, set_playhead, video_frame (AgentVideo.swift). Frames for the sheet: the server video_frame / contact_sheet tools (AgentContactSheet.swift) or Scripts/ask-eval/contact-sheet.swift. Walk ask-adds-a-title-page-walk passes today (26 s) with a plain white on black Case 1 page: queue/manager/shots/2026-10-20-1920-ask-title-ran.png. No stored subjects or per-request templates (runner-prompt Hard rules): the cases are tests, the fix for any of them is a general technique.
acceptance: The climbing set gains at least five video cases on a short sample recording, among them: a title page that says Case 1 before the clip; a cut where something happens with a dissolve across it; zooms on the clicks; subtitle pages Case 1 to 3 between three clips with one consistent look; and a request that needs a clip from the recording history (for example: put my latest recording after this one)

Each video case is scored from what plays, not from the document alone: rules read the document (the title lands before the clip, the cut sits inside the clip, no blank frame while it plays), and the judge and blind namer see a contact sheet of frames from the rendered video
The held-out set gains video cases on the same footing, kept apart by the same rule as the picture ones

Baselines run and written in the audit for Ask on this Mac and for the skill, per case, with seconds per case beside each score, and the video category shows in the eval total and its per-category lines
What Ask does today with the history request is recorded honestly (it has no add_clip in its tool set); if it fails, that is the baseline, not something this task fixes
Audit written under queue/audits/ with the contact sheets; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task log if it does not
